:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  if (!e.target.closest(".cod-sticker")) return;

  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const heart = document.createElement("span");
    heart.className = "pixel-heart";
    heart.style.left = e.clientX + "px";
    heart.style.top = e.clientY + "px";
    heart.style.setProperty("--dx", (Math.random() * 90 - 45) + "px");   // random sideways drift
    heart.style.setProperty("--s", (1 + Math.random() * 0.8).toFixed(2)); // random final size
    heart.style.animationDelay = i * 80 + "ms";                           // staggered burst
    heart.addEventListener("animationend", () => heart.remove());
    document.body.appendChild(heart);
  }
});
</script>
```
